artifacts.summary: exists_hitPresented proved sorry-free at standard axioms across three new modules (Profile, Periodic, HitComplete) with sizeBound exhibited as a count; pinned at both C14 sites and in the theorem index; README (C) row settled in general.

completion_data.completion_summary: Requirement (C)'s general row is a theorem: exists_hitPresented (HitComplete.lean) gives, for every regular Z-model, seam, formula and depth k >= 1, a finite presentation with Fintype.card Q <= sizeBound phi k satisfying HitPresented, the count N^3 * (4 P^2 + 1) exhibited in the statement. Route: the composing sigma-star profile of finite words (Profile.lean), Ramsey-over-profile forward transport and its reflection through the order dual, the seam assembly (Periodic.lean), and one three-piece gadget per triple of HitCl in a disjoint union. Fourteen phases, fourteen phase commits, zero sorry, all three headline theorems at [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].

memory_candidates.content: Reversal transfer for first-order k-types of finite words without any order-reversal formula transformation: the Ehrenfeucht-Fraisse game characterization (kEquiv_iff_backForth) is symmetric under reversing the order because its atoms are predicates at points and order atoms between two points, and reversing sends `order i j` to `order j i`. So KEquiv M N implies KEquiv (dual M) (dual N) in ~60 lines (reuse GroupModel/MonoDiscrete.lean's dualStructure and kEquiv_of_dualStructure through OrderIso.dualDual), and listSeg l.reverse is k-equivalent to the dual of listSeg l by k_equiv_of_iso. Any 'backward mirror' of a forward argument over tails of a Z-colouring then follows by reflecting the colouring (reflectColouring c p z := c p (-z)) instead of duplicating the forward proof.

A module-scoped `lake build Module` can pass while the full library build fails on a cross-module name clash (a new `dualStructure` collided with an existing one in another namespace-sharing module). Run the full guarded build before every phase commit, not only the scoped one; the status.typ regeneration hook also needs the built root library.

Rewriting a goal with an equation between two `hitOf`/Finset terms whose instance arguments were synthesized along different paths can hit an isDefEq heartbeat timeout (the unifier unfolds the Finset construction). Prove such set equalities pointwise through the membership characterization (mem_hitOf_iff) instead of rewriting with the equation form.
